name: 49684 · Traverse City, MI
findings: ZIP 49684 (Traverse City) has 186 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 57 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49684 (Traverse City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49684 (Traverse City) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
